channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Jamal Murray | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Jamal Murray from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Bennett Durando:Aaron Gordon:

“I got into the league at 18 years old, and I could roll out of bed and play 48 minutes and then go back to bed. And wake up the next day like I didn't play, ready for a back-to-back. I used to make fun of all the old guys for having to get to the gym an hour early or two hours early and do all these warm- ups and cool-downs and exercises, funky tricks of the trade they had picked up throughout their time in their career. So, year 13. (Jamal Murray interrupts:”

Aaron Gordon on Jamal Murray, Sep 28, 2026. Source: x.com.

item.title: David Adelman on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Bennett Durando:David Adelman on ball-handling:

“The amount of pressure that I put on Jamal (Murray) last season, whether we were healthy or not, was just too much.”

David Adelman on Jamal Murray, Sep 28, 2026. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Charles Lee on Jamal Murray, Kon Knueppel
item.description:
“Overall he's having a great year for anybody in the NBA. I saw something that was great. For somebody that is shooting 48% or better from the field, 40% from three and averaging 18 plus points per game or higher, there's only three players in the NBA doing that, and that's [Kevin] Durant, it's Kon Knueppel and it's Jamal Murray from Denver. And so those are two All-Star guys and he's in the same conversation with them, too. So it's pretty incredible what he's doing as a rookie, the historical feats that he's matching, but he's also just been really efficient as an NBA player.”

Charles Lee on Jamal Murray, Kon Knueppel, Apr 9, 2026. Source: Sirius XM.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Nikola Jokic on Jamal Murray:

“Yeah, I think fatherhood changed him a little bit,and I think that’s a really big part of his life right now, which is normal. As a player, I think he’s played really well for the last three years, maybe three and a half. He had an injury and had to come back from that, but I think he’s been really, really good over the last two or three years. This year is just, how do you say, an accomplishment or whatever, but I think he’s been playing at that level for the last two or three years.”

Nikola Jokic on Jamal Murray, Mar 22, 2026. Source: YouTube.

item.title: David Adelman on Aaron Gordon, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray
item.description:
David Adelman:

“Yeah, I mean it was a lot of conversations with Ben and John and Josh. I think we were trying to find pieces that fit — not just names that people knew. We feel like all these guys do complement the group that’s been here, the group that’s accomplished so much over all these years in Denver. And I can tell you right now just from my messaging with Aaron Gordon, Jamal Murray, Nikola Jokic — those guys are excited. And that brings something new for us. They feel like a new gym is going to be there. And for those guys who have been around for so long, sometimes you need that. You need a little bit of change, and this change is a good change.”

David Adelman on Aaron Gordon, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Jul 16, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: LeBron James on Julius Randle, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jamal Murray, Alex Caruso
item.description:
LeBron James:

“And then (the Thunder) come off the bench with one of my favorite teammates of all time, Alex Caruso, who is like the dog. He's the ultimate Swiss Army knife. We've literally seen him guard Giannis. We've seen him guard the Joker. You know, we've seen him guard Ant, we've seen him guard Julius Randle, we've seen him guard Jamal Murray throughout this whole postseason.”

LeBron James on Julius Randle, Giannis Antetokounmpo, Jamal Murray, Alex Caruso, Jun 4, 2025. Source: YouTube.

item.title: David Adelman on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Adelman shouts out the medical staff for getting Jamal Murray to a point where he could play and play well.

“That’s Jamal Murray. It’s almost like the worse it is, the better he’s going to be,”

David Adelman on Jamal Murray, May 16, 2025. Source: Twitter @VBenedetto.

item.title: Michael Malone on Jamal Murray
item.description:
“Jamal Murray didn't pay himself $[52] million [per season]. We did that as an organization, because we believe in him.”

Michael Malone on Jamal Murray, Jan 15, 2025. Source: ESPN.

item.title: Michael Malone on Jamal Murray
item.description:
“And I know we all got excited from that game he had in Sacramento, when he took over in the fourth quarter. ‘Hey, maybe this is a game that gets him going.’ AndI think he’s built on it. Tonight you saw it. He had moments and flashes where he was shooting the ball aggressively. We always say it, right? An aggressive Jamal Murray is an effective Jamal Murray.”

Michael Malone on Jamal Murray, Dec 29, 2024. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Michael Malone on Jamal Murray
item.description:
“I know that everybody is really riding Jamal Murray really hard right now. That’s not gonna do him any favors, man,”

Michael Malone on Jamal Murray, Dec 29, 2024. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Russell Westbrook on Jamal Murray
item.description:
The main reason that Westbrook now calls Denver home is one of the NBA’s worst-kept secrets.

“It’s my job to push [Jamal Murray] every night to be the best that he can be,”

Russell Westbrook on Jamal Murray, Oct 24, 2024. Source: For The Win.

item.title: Shaquille O'Neal on John Paxson, Kyrie Irving, Jamal Murray
item.description:
Shaquille O'Neal:

“I get annoyed when people cherry-pick moments in a player's career. Who took the winning shot in Game 7 in 2016? Kyrie Irving. Who hit the game-winner in 1993? John Paxson. Who hit the game-winner last night for Denver? Jamal Murray. That's the sport of basketball—sometimes it's your time, sometimes it's your teammates'.”

Shaquille O'Neal on John Paxson, Kyrie Irving, Jamal Murray, May 6, 2024. Source: YouTube.

item.title: Michael Malone on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Nuggets coach Michael Malone on Jamal Murray, who will be out vs Clippers for 7th consecutive game with right knee inflammation:

“Jamal can probably go out there and play tonight. But the bigger question is can you go out there and play effectively? Can you go out there and play your game? Jamal is not at that point yet. We’re not going to rush him back or force him back.”

Michael Malone on Jamal Murray, Apr 4, 2024. Source: Twitter @MarkG_Medina.

item.title: Michael Malone on Reggie Jackson, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray
item.description:
“We probably had quite a few minutes of that tonight. … Reggie, I think, has done a really good job in place of Jamal. But just like if Nikola goes down, we don’t have another Nikola Jokic. We don’t have another Jamal Murray.”

Michael Malone on Reggie Jackson, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Nov 25, 2023. Source: Hoops Rumors.

item.title: Michael Malone on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Michael Malone:

“I want Jamal Murray to be a first-time All-Star this season. I want him to be an All-NBA player. He's got to do it in October. He can't be a slow starter.”

Michael Malone on Jamal Murray, Oct 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray
item.description:
Katy Winge:Aaron Gordon on his responsibility when Murray/Jokić are in the two-man game:

“I do what I love to do. That's what's so great about it. I get to play the dunker. So I work the baseline, catch alley-oops and drop-off passes and get to bang out. It's awesome.”

Aaron Gordon on Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Jun 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @katywinge.

item.title: Michael Malone on Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray
item.description:
Michael Malone on Nikola Jokic and Jamal Murray:

“By far their greatest performance as a duo in their seven years together.”

Michael Malone on Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Jun 7, 2023. Source: Twitter @melissarohlin.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Aaron Gordon on Jamal Murray:

“Blue Arrow’s one of the best guards in the league and one of the best scorers in the league. When he’s locked in and he’s engaged, he’s up there with the best players in the world.”

Aaron Gordon on Jamal Murray, Jun 2, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Michael Malone on Jamal Murray struggling in previous matchups against the Heat:

“I have all of the confidence in the world that Jamal will be ready for this stage.”

Michael Malone on Jamal Murray, Jun 1, 2023. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Aaron Gordon on the Nikola Jokić/Jamal Murray tandem:

“That’s a bad duo. Those are bad boys out there…you could stack that duo against anybody, and when I say anybody I mean anybody.”

Aaron Gordon on Jamal Murray, May 23, 2023. Source: Twitter @NBABlackburn.

item.title: Jeff Green on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Jeff Green on Jamal Murray:

“He’s proven that he’s one of the best guards in this league.”

Jeff Green on Jamal Murray, May 21, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Michael Malone on Jamal Murray:

“This is not just coach and player. I love Jamal Murray. This is not just I'm coaching him. We've been together for seven years. We've been together through a lot of ups and downs... I saw the dark days coming back from the ACL. For him to be playing at the level he’s at, I'm just so happy for the man.”

Michael Malone on Jamal Murray, May 18, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Michael Malone on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Katy Winge:Coach Michael Malone on Jamal Murray:

“Add to the legend of playoff Jamal Murray. 34, 9, 5 & just some big big shots.”

Michael Malone on Jamal Murray, Apr 29, 2023. Source: Twitter @katywinge.

item.title: Jaden McDaniels on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Dane Moore:Jaden McDaniels:

“It was hard watching Jamal Murray run around. I was mad I couldn't chase him.”

Jaden McDaniels on Jamal Murray, Apr 27, 2023. Source: Twitter @DaneMooreNBA.

item.title: Michael Malone on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Michael Malone on Jamal Murray:

“That guy, he lives for big moments. Never afraid. We needed him to have that type of game tonight.”

Michael Malone on Jamal Murray, Apr 26, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Nikola Jokic on Jamal Murray:

“I think he's playing now better than in the bubble. Yes, he scored a lot more points in the bubble, or whatever, but I think his energy is much better. His leadership, his -- not focus -- just like being into the game, it's at a much higher level.”

Nikola Jokic on Jamal Murray, Apr 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Nikola Jokic on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Harrison Wind:Nikola Jokic on his partnership with Jamal Murray and watching him grow as a player over the last several years:

“We never have arguments. I mean, we do, but it's in the game so we don't think about it. We learn a lot from each other and we are getting better together.”

Nikola Jokic on Jamal Murray, Apr 20, 2023. Source: Twitter @HarrisonWind.

item.title: Aaron Gordon on Michael Malone, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Michael Porter
item.description:
“I’m here to win a championship for Joker (Nikola Jokic).Joker’s here to win a championship for Jamal (Murray) and Michael Malone and Michael Porter. KCP, we’re looking to get him another one. I’m not doing this for myself. I’m doing it for the guys around me.”

Aaron Gordon on Michael Malone, Nikola Jokic, Jamal Murray, Michael Porter, Mar 8, 2023. Source: Denver Post.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Jamal Murray
item.description:
Only 12 players go to the World Cup or Olympics, and there are two players committed to Team Canada who are on European pro teams (Kevin Pangos, Melvin Ejim), so there is some room to maneuver by a player or two when it comes time for Nurse and Canada’s deep thinkers to submit a final roster.

“Going right to him (Murray), I would say that’s a little bit of a tough one,”

Nick Nurse on Jamal Murray, Feb 27, 2023. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Jamal Murray
item.description:
“I would say he is fully committed. He came to all the camps. He really wants to play. He’s got a lot of season left. He’s got a playoff run left. I think if he comes through healthy and he’s good I think so (for Murray) at the World Cup.”

Nick Nurse on Jamal Murray, Feb 27, 2023. Source: The Athletic.
